description:
Powerful 1500W Peak Motor

Powered by a 1500W peak motor and a 5-level pedal assist system (PAS), the C300R SO delivers reliable, high-performance power that transforms every ride. At PAS level 1, responsive torque ensures effortless starts; at level 5, top speed reaches 32 MPH—flattening hills, cutting through headwinds, and making longer routes feel effortless. Built with sinusoidal wave technology for smooth operation, low noise, and high temperature resistance, this motor delivers consistent stability across varied terrains with a lifespan exceeding 200,000 hours. Powerful performance, made effortlessly smooth.

26"×4.0" All-Terrain Fat Tires & Full Suspension: Built to Conquer Anything

Built with a rugged step-over frame and hydroformed aluminum that absorbs impact like a champ, this all-terrain beast is ready for rocky trails, city streets, and gravel paths alike. Equipped with 26"×4" puncture-resistant fat tires and deep-groove tread, it delivers max traction on flat roads, mountain trails, snow, and gravel—steady stability, cushioned feel, ride anything, anywhere. The fully adjustable front and rear suspension features 100mm front fork travel and a rear shock absorber, delivering up to 40% more comfort compared to bikes without rear suspension by absorbing bumps and rough terrain for a smoother ride.

180mm Rear Hydraulic Brake: Confident, Controlled Stopping

Equipped with a 180mm rear hydraulic disc brake and high-performance pads, it delivers 30% shorter stopping distance and 60% more braking power—giving you confident, controlled braking on rugged trails or steep descents. Ride safer, stop smarter.

Shimano 8-Speed Drivetrain & Sensitive Twist Throttle: Precision Meets Raw Power

The Shimano 8-speed drivetrain delivers precise, smooth gear changes, letting you tackle steep climbs or cruise with ease—whether you prefer traditional riding or electric-assisted power. When raw power is what you need, the sensitive twist throttle responds instantly: explosive acceleration, effortless climbing, total domination from city streets to mountain trails.

Monochrome LCD & NFC: Smart Control at Your Fingertips

The LCD display clearly shows speed, battery level, distance, and assist mode at a glance. Quickly wake your display with a simple NFC tap for effortless riding—no fumbling for keys or buttons. An intuitive interface that keeps you informed and in control.

Adjustable Comfort Saddle & Integrated Lighting: Ride Longer, Ride Safer

The seat height adjusts easily to your ideal riding position, with high-elastic padding for excellent shock absorption and support—reducing fatigue even on longer rides. A front headlight with two high-intensity LED bulbs offers 30% more brightness for clear visibility, while the rear red LED illuminates when braking, serving as a clear warning signal for safer night rides.
